title: The operating model
thesis: This is not a chatbot layer for operations. It is a harness model for systems that investigate, prove, remember, replay, self-correct, and improve.
publicSafeSource: This language is distilled from public-safe product work around AI-native incident investigation and operational control planes. It avoids internal employer systems, proprietary names, screenshots, logs, and confidential architecture.

principles.name: Deterministic first
principles.description: Known operational paths should be reproducible before an LLM is allowed to add judgment.

principles.name: Proof-driven
principles.description: Every conclusion needs evidence references, missing-context statements, and confidence movement.

principles.name: Bounded autonomy
principles.description: Tool use, time, scope, and irreversible actions need explicit budgets and policy gates.

principles.name: Receipts everywhere
principles.description: Each tool call, observation, hypothesis, and decision should leave an auditable trail.

principles.name: Replay as trust
principles.description: The best investigation systems can replay the same evidence path without re-running the world.

principles.name: Operator control plane
principles.description: The UI should expose evidence, risk, confidence, memory, and approval gates in one place.
